scientific_scope: E05 only; joint dependency and conditional robustness checks; no new observations or observational refits; frozen R132 map and R133 records remain unchanged

threshold_definitions.flux_residual: max component discrepancy divided by max(1,abs(flux_left),abs(flux_right)); both native and independently dimensionalized checks
threshold_definitions.characteristic_guard: minimum distance of abs(front-relative normal speed) to any characteristic speed, divided by max(1,all speeds); the same relative guard on characteristic-speed coincidences
threshold_definitions.entropy_guard: dimensionless log(p2/p1)-gamma*log(X); ordinary accepted shock must exceed the guard
threshold_definitions.tangential_LOS_relative: abs(v_t dot ell)/max(1 km/s, norm(v_t)); explicitly calculated for both constructed states and their difference
threshold_definitions.guard_policy: Guarded candidates are UNRESOLVED, retained in root records and never used for a decisive ordinary-family claim. Existing R131 diagnostic thresholds are unchanged; the extra R132 conditioning guards are applied separately.

joint_domain_type: Finite retained source/reduction/closure scenarios, not a joint confidence region or physical prior; all unbounded unknowns remain explicitly unknown
dependency_rules: Temperature and effective density remain paired by the same saved atomic-response fit.
Centroid and density always use the same retained EIS aperture; no Cartesian mixing across apertures.
Reference choices share the target spectrum and are overlapping alternatives; they are not independent samples.
The 336 and 371 km/s published means are alternative speed-proxy assignments, not simultaneous exact local-speed measurements or error endpoints.
Formal centroid sigma and conditional density profile bounds are not multiplied into an invented joint error box. Their common spectral/calibration dependencies remain explicit.

Density scale cancels from normalized ideal-MHD admissibility at fixed T, d and geometry; the saved positive density-profile limits rescale fields by sqrt(ne) and densities by ne, without serving as independent model parameters.
The 16 R133 EIS–AIA registrations relocate the same detector aperture; they do not provide 16 independent Doppler or density measurements.

Upstream normal velocity and absolute line zero point have no independent measured finite bound in the retained records. Numeric flow tests below are conditional stress scenarios, not observational bounds.
AIA brightness is not converted to density compression, normal or shock association. Its emission-response/background nuisance factors are not measured.

stationary_upstream_scan.frozen_R132_tuple: Reuse matching saved R132 nodes without rerunning them; new tuples use complete polynomial root enumeration.
stationary_upstream_scan.coverage: Every algebraic root at every declared node is retained; no exclusion claim from unsampled cell interiors.

unknown_normal_flow_stress_scan.definition: S is front speed relative to upstream plasma; S=factor*sqrt(gamma*2*kB*T2/mp). D_lab=V*cos(alpha); v1n=D_lab-S; X=S/(S-d/mu).
unknown_normal_flow_stress_scan.category: ASSUMED symmetric-family stress domain around sonic scale, not an observed flow range; unknown velocities outside it are not excluded.

normal_flow_separator: A changes sign at Scrit=(delta_vn+sqrt(4*delta_vn^2+9*cs2^2))/3. This is a necessary ordinary-family condition, not a sufficient root or observation.
alternative_discriminator_tests: Joint measured tuple compatibility and inherited root preservation
Full inherited and new accepted-family projections of compression, upstream temperature/density, field strengths and flow
Signed total magnetic-field change under standard tangential ideal-MHD jump relations
No global finite precision inferred from selected witness separation; numerical guards remain unresolved
exclusion_policy: Widening a set that contains an accepted witness cannot exclude that witness. Exclusion needs an independent jointly incompatible observational requirement. No such requirement is assumed in advance.
numerical_guard_policy: UNRESOLVED stays explicit. New checks never relabel the saved R132 result. Finite grid counts are not probabilities or volume fractions.
